name: c03-staggered-joint-step-resources-v1
unmerged_dependency: PR21 at exact source_commit; PR22 engine code is not included

resource_policy.scope: one shared site pool per RID, shared by both aircraft
resource_policy.steps: strict serial INSPECT then SERVICE per mission
resource_policy.INSPECT: 10 minutes of one P-SPECIALIST; release at step completion
resource_policy.SERVICE: 40 minutes; acquire one P-SPECIALIST and one E-SHARED together or acquire neither
resource_policy.waiting: no SERVICE lease while queued; INSPECT lease has already been released
resource_policy.retention: nonpreemptive; no resource consumption, transit, loss, reservation across steps, or hold until launch
resource_policy.queue: oldest request first; distinct main-case requests avoid initial simultaneous request arbitration
resource_policy.wake: grant at earliest feasible completion time in the proposed common contract; native wake latency is unverified
resource_policy.variants: only E-SHARED capacity changes from 1 to 2; P-SPECIALIST stays 2

event_contract.identity: stable mission, aircraft, process, step, RID and lease identity required; no aggregate-count substitution
logical_causality: release before a grant that needs that released unit
planned launch time is a lower bound
event_contract.native_phase_status: blocked_unverified; equal printed timestamps are not phase-order evidence
event_contract.same_time_cross_resource_order: not inferred; compare left/right occupancy and per-lease causes, then record native micro-order only if exposed
event_contract.aircraft_binding: AIR-A and AIR-B are proposed business identities; bind by observed full native identities before pairing, never silently swap after mismatch
event_contract.identity_gate: QTYPS=2 and mission type labels do not prove selection order or exact native instance indices

time_boundaries.nominal_deadline_mapping: STIM+DTIM is a hypothesis for an already selected aircraft, not a proven missing-aircraft cutoff
time_boundaries.main_case: both capacities complete prep strictly before nominal deadline; no cancellation behavior exercised
time_boundaries.cut_policy: read-only left/right snapshots; do not cancel tasks, release resources, shorten work, or treat RCEND as SIMPE
time_boundaries.deadline_tie_probe: deferred and blocked until parent acceptance and GUI review; separately test completion just before/at/after STIM+DTIM without pre-assigning cancellation or refund behavior
time_boundaries.horizon_policy: all proposed work finishes by 570; crossing-horizon execution is not tested

previously_observed: ENLOG mission creation/allocation/start/completion and ready transitions for A01/A02
ResourceResults column names in prior J35 export
required_for_new_acceptance: lease owner, RID, quantity, grant, release and causal step
step start/completion and remaining work at observation cuts
left/right capacity snapshots at release/grant boundaries
not_yet_exposed_or_mapped: ResourceResults column meanings and interval aggregation
POINT sharing scope across two instances
observability.rule: absence of native visibility blocks the corresponding claim; derived ledger must be labeled derived and cannot replace raw evidence

native_candidate.input_kind: row-schema-compatible JSON candidate, not converted or accepted SXI
native_candidate.source: SHA-pinned existing native schema and A01 writer
native_candidate.preparation_mapping: MissionPreparation.TID=PREP; DURN equals serial TaskBreakDown.DURN sum; effective timing behavior unverified
native_candidate.resource_mapping: SubTaskResource entries; TaskResource deliberately empty to avoid double demand; activation/holding scope blocked_unverified
native_candidate.category_mapping: distinct P-SPECIALIST/E-SHARED RIDs express business categories; native TYPE=SPECIAL for both does not prove a native personnel-specialty classifier
native_candidate.pool_mapping: ResourceAllocation POINT=RESOURCE-AIR at BASE-01; one row per RID, QTYPS=2; sharing must be probed

forbidden_claims: same RNG stream from equal seed
